item.title: FOUND: 76-year-old Cincinnati woman with dementia
item.description: DAYTON, Ohio (WDTN) – An Endangered Missing Adult Alert was issued by the Cincinnati Communication Center for a 76-year-old woman who has dementia. The alert was canceled at approximately 11:45 a.m. on Sunday.

item.title: Officials investigate vehicle crash on I-75 near Stanley Avenue
item.description: DAYTON, Ohio (WDTN) – Officials are working to learn more after a vehicle crashed into the median on I-75 near Stanley Avenue late Saturday night. According to Montgomery County Regional Dispatch, the crash happened at approximately 10:55 p.m. The lane was closed for multiple hours during the crash investigation, and it reopened on Sunday morning.
